description: Power Systems Reliability Assessment, published by Matrixeigs, implements sequential and non-sequential Monte Carlo reliability calculations for generation adequacy and composite generation-transmission adequacy, using the IEEE RTS-24 test system. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README describes MATLAB while the repository API lists Julia as its dominant language; the implementation mix was not inspected. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support resilience, capacity planning studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
name: Power Systems Reliability Assessment
notes: The provider documents a reusable reliability package, not only an unimplemented method. Original discovery: A1/A1-0002. Geography and simulation-use tags are screening classifications.
